Authentic and Family Friendly Dining Place
Sep 2026 • Family
From the moment we arrived at Viet Kitchen, Renaissance Riverside Saigon, Thuy, the Navigator, and the entire team welcomed our family with exceptional warmth and genuine Vietnamese hospitality. During our stay from 28 August to 4 September 2026, they made us feel completely at home, taking special care to ensure our young child was comfortable, happy, and warmly included.

The authentic Vietnamese cuisine was a true highlight. The selection was excellent, and the Vietnamese station offered vibrant local flavours that brought the dining experience to life. We especially enjoyed the steaming pho and rich, aromatic Vietnamese coffee—both delicious, satisfying, and wonderfully authentic.

What made our experience truly memorable was the heartfelt service from every member of the team. Their friendly smiles, thoughtful attention, and sincere care created a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere for our family throughout our stay.

We will certainly return to Renaissance Riverside Hotel on our next visit to Ho Chi Minh City.
